entities.name: Vhati il-Dal
entities.description: Ambitious second-in-command to Greven il-Vec on Rath, killed when Greven threw him overboard.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: Brutal commander on Rath who boarded the Weatherlight and fought Gerrard.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Fought Greven and was thrown overboard from the Weatherlight but survived.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane where Greven and Vhati served.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: Ship that Vhati was put in charge of.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship that planeshifted to Rath and was boarded by Greven.

events.summary: Vhati was put in charge of Predator while Greven oversaw the boarding of the Weatherlight.
events.quote: He was placed in charge of Predator while Greven personally oversaw the boarding of Weatherlight

events.summary: Vhati fired a cannon at Greven, missed, and struck the Weatherlight's deck, throwing Gerrard overboard.
events.quote: decided to fire one of Predator ’s cannons at his commander

events.summary: Greven threw Vhati overboard in retaliation and Vhati did not survive the fall.
events.quote: Greven immediately stalked back to Predator and retaliated by throwing the grovelling Vhati overboard as well.

relations.quote: Vhati il-Dal was Greven il -Vec 's ambitious second-in-command on Rath
Unlike Gerrard, Vhati did not survive the fall.
